theorem_title: Existence of admissible approximation parameters for pi
natural_language_statement: For every exponent ν greater than 2 and positive constants Λ and c, if π admits arbitrarily large rational approximations with error at most q⁻ᵛ, then there is a nonempty family of admissible parameters satisfying the published approximation, dimension, collision, and weight-margin conditions.
explanation: The construction combines the published Parameters record with proved dimension, rational-sigma, uniform-margin, normalized-approximation, and minimum-weight children. The source target is renamed with the source017 suffix to distinguish it from an existing platform theorem.
